hints.content:
To measure slope, we pick any two points on the line. Then we look at the horizontal and vertical distances between those points.



[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: A coordinate plane. The x- and y-axes each scale by one. A graph of a line intersects the points zero, two and two, negative one. There is a horizontal dotted segment from zero, two to two, two that is labeled two. There is a vertical dotted segment from two, two to two, negative one that is labeled negative three.

hints.content: The slope of the line is $-\dfrac{3}{2}$.
